name: Hei Zhi Zhang
source:
"Hei Zhi Zhang" tells a story about Andy, a Samoyed police officer, who obtained a magic eyes seeing the flow of events around him. Due to fear and a tragic memories of his new abilities, he had sealed his power away. He then became a detective and with Gray, a senior in the police academy, jointly investigated a vicious serial murder case - the skinning case because of the transfer of his position. When his life suddenly changed dramatically, Andy's magic eyes gradually re-awakened. Skinners, cult rituals, aliens, spiritual spells, and the ensuing strange incidents forced him to face his forgotten past.

[Translated from [url=https://blackchapter.itch.io/blackchapter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《黑之章》讲述了萨摩耶警员安迪的故事。他获得了一双能看穿事物运转的流动之魔眼，却因恐惧与这份新能力带来的悲惨回忆，将力量封印起来。此后，他成为了一名刑警，又因职位调动，与警校前辈格雷一同调查恶性的连环杀人案——剥皮案。当生活突然发生剧变，安迪的魔眼也逐渐重新觉醒。剥皮者、邪教仪式、异形、招魂咒术，以及接踵而至的怪异事件，迫使他直面被自己遗忘的过去。

[译自[url=https://blackchapter.itch.io/blackchapter]itch.io[/url]]
